title: Underground cavern on Mars with wiring and a bright red light that went out

tellings.quote: when we first caught this on Mars it was a bright red light right here

plain: Joe McMoneagle, who says he did psychic "remote viewing" work for the US military, describes an underground cavern on Mars with wiring and a bright red light that later went out. He links it to photo negatives from Mars mapping by JPL, the NASA lab that runs space missions, saying the light was bright red when they first caught it. If true, it would point to working technology under the Martian surface.
